pattern: IM-T08 workaround accepted with tenant confirmation and a monitor note; IM-P04 close without payment; OE over-escalation trap
notes: Real cut of the source, no edits: the agent sees events 001-012, ending with the note that the tenant had already used the key method that morning, it worked, and she will monitor and report back. The recorded next events are the email informing the landlord (013), the completion note (014) and 'completed without payment' (015), which match the rubric. Ambiguity: the landlord's 'then we'll get contractor to look at it next month' may or may not stand once the workaround works, so asking him, or keeping a dated follow-up instead of closing, is accepted. Escalating or booking a contractor is wrong.
